title: Give every acceptance Given/When/Then prose and a verifiable outcome

facts.note: Planning artifacts declaring WMBT nodes with acceptances[] are identifiable by file kind/path.
Validator checks every acceptance under every WMBT at CONFIRM (confirm-blocking), whether or not the acceptance was recently authored or edited; needs a phase observer.
Also relevant while an acceptance under a WMBT node is being authored or changed, so the planner gets it right before CONFIRM; not a precondition for CONFIRM validation.
Missing/empty given/when/then.abstract or no verifiable then line is a validator finding.
Whether a then line states an assertable outcome (vs. a vague or placeholder statement) partly needs judgement.

fires: CONFIRM runs over a plan whose WMBT nodes declare acceptances, including existing, unchanged acceptances.
Planner adds a new acceptance under a WMBT node in a plan or wagon.
Planner edits an existing acceptance's given/when/then abstract prose.
An acceptance's then line is a placeholder such as TBD, TODO or N/A.
An acceptance has an empty or missing given, when or then abstract.
doesNotFire: Judging whether a WMBT has enough acceptances (set completeness) — that is planner.coverage.every-wmbt-must-have.
Planning docs or nodes that declare no acceptances under a WMBT node.
Outside CONFIRM, edits to implementation code or tests that do not touch acceptance declarations (at CONFIRM all declared acceptances are still validated).

given: A WMBT node in a plan declares one or more acceptances.
when: The planner authors or edits an acceptance under that WMBT, or CONFIRM validates every declared acceptance.
then: Each acceptance has present, non-empty Given/When/Then abstract prose, and at least one Then line states a verifiable outcome a generated test can assert.
prefer: Write Given as the preconditions, When as the trigger action, and Then as the expected observable outcomes.
Phrase at least one Then line as a concrete, assertable observable outcome.
avoid: Leaving given, when or then abstract missing or empty.
Using a bare placeholder token (TBD, TODO, N/A) as the outcome — it is not a verifiable outcome.
Filling the fields with non-empty filler to pass the presence check while stating no assertable outcome.
Treating a well-formed acceptance as proof the WMBT's acceptance set is complete — this rule checks local shape only.
why: An acceptance whose narrative is missing, empty, or states no assertable outcome cannot be turned into a test, so its WMBT is unverifiable in practice while appearing covered on paper.
evidence: Validator conventions/presence/test_acceptance_well_formed passes for every acceptance under every WMBT node (fault-injection test: missing GWT prose is caught).
On failure, the finding reports node_id, missing_field and node_location of the offending acceptance.
verifier_detail: Validation family: presence; template: required_field_presence; variant: acceptance_well_formed; subject_kind: acceptance.
Phase: CONFIRM; enforcement: confirm-blocking; severity 3; disposition strict.
Selector: every acceptance declared under a wmbt node. Traversal: wmbt -> acceptances[] -> given/when/then.abstract.
Invariant: given/when/then abstract prose is present and non-empty, and at least one then line states a verifiable outcome.
Bare placeholder tokens TBD, TODO, N/A do not count as a verifiable outcome.
Failure evidence fields: node_id, missing_field, node_location.
Scope is local shape only; set completeness is checked by planner.coverage.every-wmbt-must-have.
